question: In March 2025, the government of which of the following states announced to bring 5,000 hectares under afforestation during the year 2025-2026?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Himachal Pradesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The government of **Himachal Pradesh**, during the presentation of its administrative goals in **March 2025**, announced a significant environmental target to bring **5,000 hectares** of land under **afforestation** during the financial year **2025-2026**.
 
• This initiative is part of the state's broader vision to enhance its **green cover** and mitigate the impacts of **climate change** in the fragile **Himalayan ecosystem**. ***Hence, the statement regarding the 5,000-hectare target is correct for Himachal Pradesh.***
 
• The **afforestation** drive will focus on the plantation of **broad-leaved trees** and species that are resilient to **forest fires**, which is a major concern for the state during the summer months.
 
• The **Himachal Pradesh Forest Department** has been designated as the nodal agency to identify degraded forest lands and community lands for this massive plantation exercise.
 
• The project also aims to involve **local communities** and **Panchayati Raj Institutions** to ensure the survival rate of the saplings and to promote **community-led conservation**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Geographical and Forest Profile:**
 
 
• **Himachal Pradesh** has a total geographical area of **55,673 sq km**, out of which a significant portion is classified under recorded forest area.
 
• According to the **India State of Forest Report (ISFR)**, the state has been consistently working to increase its **forest cover** from the current levels to reach the national goal of **33%**.
 
• The state is home to diverse flora, including **Deodar (Cedrus deodara)**, **Oak**, **Kail**, and **Chir Pine**.
 
 
 
• **Green State Vision:**
 
 
• The **Government of Himachal Pradesh** has set an ambitious target to transform the state into a **"Green Energy State"** by **March 31, 2026**.
 
• The **afforestation** target of **5,000 hectares** for **2025-2026** complements this vision by creating **carbon sinks** to offset emissions.
 
 
 
• **Economic and Ecological Importance:**
 
 
• Forests in **Himachal Pradesh** play a crucial role in **watershed management**, providing water to several downstream states in **North India** through rivers like the **Beas**, **Ravi**, and **Sutlej**.
 
• **Eco-tourism** is a major source of revenue for the state, which is directly dependent on the preservation of its **natural landscapes** and **wildlife habitats**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Major Schemes:**
 
 
• The state implements various schemes like **"Ek Buta Beti Ke Naam,"** where saplings are planted to celebrate the birth of a girl child, linking **social forestry** with **gender empowerment**.
 
• The **"Mukhyamantri Van Vistaar Yojana"** is another key initiative focused on expanding **greenery** in barren and rocky terrains.
 
 
 
• **Climate Resilience:**
 
 
• The **2025-2026** plan emphasizes **soil moisture conservation** through the construction of **check dams** and **ponds** alongside afforestation to prevent **soil erosion** and **landslides**.
 
• The state has also been exploring **carbon credit** mechanisms to incentivize **sustainable forest management**.
